workouts.title: Strict Handstand Push-Up
workouts.description:
OPTION A.
For Time:
20 - 50 Strict Handstand Push-Up
NOTES:
- Make note of your total time . reps and how you broke this up.

OPTION B.
5 Sets:
Max Reps Box Pike Handstand Push-Ups
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Take each of these sets to near failure. Stop just short of failure on sets 1-3, on sets 4 and 5 go all the way to failure. There will be a large drop off in total reps from set one to set five; that is okay!

workouts.title: Tempo Pause Front Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Front Squat
4x2 @ 12x1 Tempo / RPE 7
Rest 2:00-3:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- "12x1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- This is a deload week. Build to a weight to use for all three sets that is moderate, but you could still do about three more reps with if you wanted to on each set.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.

workouts.title: Wide Grip Pause Bench Press
workouts.description:
Wide Grip Pause Bench Press
3x8 @ Add your Personal Record below // RPE 7
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Pause for :02 on your chest.
- Wide grip should be 1-2'' wider than your normal bench press grip. It should not feel uncomfortably wide.

NOTES:
- This piece should start around an RPE 6 and finish at RPE 9.
- If you don't have a bike erg you can sub 12/9 cals on the fan bike.

workouts.title: Conditioning
workouts.description:
EMOM 40:
1: 12-15/10-12 Cal Fan Bike
2: 5 Dumbbell Thruster @ 2x50/2x35lbs + Max Rep
Burpee Over Dumbbell Until :30
3: 12-15/10-12 Cal Row
4: 40-60 Double Unders
NOTES:
- The fan bike and row should be completed in :45 or less, scale accordingly.
- The dumbbell thrusters are to be done with two dumbbells. Choose a weight that you can do unbroken. Complete the burpees as lateral burpees over one dumbbell.
